categories.title: Quiz and assessment engine

categories.accessibility: All question types operable by keyboard and screen reader; timers configurable with accommodations; no colour-only feedback.

categories.title: Competency intelligence
categories.secondary: Trainer; Competency framework administrator; Department administrator

categories.title: Role intelligence

categories.title: Personalization
categories.human_review: Recommendations are explainable and dismissible; nothing becomes mandatory without a human assignment.
categories.security: Personalisation uses only the learner's own data and the organisation's approved catalogue.
categories.accessibility: Plans and cards readable by screen readers; no motion-dependent interactions.

categories.title: AI learning tutor
categories.human_review: Tutor output is advisory; learners can flag responses; flagged responses are reviewable by trainers.

categories.title: Administration

features.name: AI-based competency assessment
features.description: Runs a role-based initial assessment built only from human-approved questions and converts the results into per-competency estimates. AI assists question creation; the score calculation itself is deterministic in MVP.
features.business_value: Gives each learner an evidence-based starting point instead of a self-declared skill list.
features.data_required: Approved Question records tagged to competency, topic and difficulty; RoleCompetency required levels; AssessmentAttempt and Answer records.
features.ai_involvement: Indirect: questions are AI-generated then human-approved (AI-007, ASM-027). Scoring is rule-based (AI_SYSTEM_SPEC.md §25).
features.human_review_required: Required: estimates and generated artefacts are reviewable and correctable by authorised humans; never used for automated employment decisions (SECURITY_RESPONSIBLE_AI.md §HID).
features.implementation_status: Planned - No application code exists yet.
features.api_requirements: Planned internal API (docs/API_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md): POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/attempts; PUT /api/v1/attempts/{id}/answers/{question_id}; POST /api/v1/attempts/{id}/submit; GET /api/v1/attempts/{id}/result
features.security_considerations: Organisation-scoped data; learner personal data never sent to an AI provider without authorisation (RAI-016); every AI call logged (SEC-011).
features.accessibility_considerations: Results readable by screen readers; charts have table equivalents; plain-language explanations.
features.failure_cases: Too few approved questions for a competency -> that competency is reported as 'insufficient evidence'. Session interrupted -> attempt resumable until expiry.
features.acceptance_criteria: An attempt produces estimates only from approved questions; each estimate links to its evidence; competencies below the minimum item count show 'insufficient evidence' instead of a score.

features.description: Compares each estimated competency level with the level required by the learner's selected job role and lists gaps by size.
features.business_value: Turns assessment results into a concrete, prioritised development need.
features.data_required: UserCompetency estimates with evidence sufficiency; RoleCompetency required levels.
features.human_review_required: Required: estimates and generated artefacts are reviewable and correctable by authorised humans; never used for automated employment decisions (SECURITY_RESPONSIBLE_AI.md §HID).
features.implementation_status: Planned - No application code exists yet.
features.api_requirements: Planned internal API (docs/API_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md): GET /api/v1/me/competency-gaps; GET /api/v1/users/{id}/competency-gaps (scoped roles)
features.security_considerations: Organisation-scoped data; learner personal data never sent to an AI provider without authorisation (RAI-016); every AI call logged (SEC-011).
features.accessibility_considerations: Results readable by screen readers; charts have table equivalents; plain-language explanations.
features.failure_cases: No job role selected -> prompt to select one. Role has no required levels -> 'role not configured' shown to learner and competency administrator.
features.acceptance_criteria: A gap is shown only when a required level exists and evidence sufficiency is at least 'medium'; each gap shows required level, estimated level, evidence link and suggested next step.

features.name: Quiz and MCQ generation
features.description: Generates candidate multiple-choice questions from licence-permitted, approved document chunks using structured output; every candidate goes through validation and human review.
features.business_value: Reduces trainer effort to create source-grounded question banks.
features.data_required: DocumentChunk text from materials whose licence permits derivative use; Topic; Competency; generation parameters.
features.ai_involvement: LLM structured generation behind the provider interface (AI_SYSTEM_SPEC.md §21).
features.human_review_required: Required: no generated question is used in an assessment before approval.
features.implementation_status: Planned - No application code exists yet.
features.ui_requirements: Quiz builder (select sources, topic, competency, count, difficulty) with job progress.
features.security_considerations: Organisation-scoped data; learner personal data never sent to an AI provider without authorisation (RAI-016); every AI call logged (SEC-011).
features.accessibility_considerations: Results readable by screen readers; charts have table equivalents; plain-language explanations.
features.failure_cases: Provider timeout -> retry with backoff; schema-invalid output -> discarded and logged; zero valid questions -> job completes with reasons.
features.acceptance_criteria: Every generated question stores source chunk IDs, evidence span, model, prompt version, timestamp and validation status, and starts as 'pending_validation'; none is learner-visible before approval.
features.future_extensions: True/false, fill-in-the-blank, scenario types (ASM-002 to ASM-005); multilingual generation (ACC-005).

features.human_review_required: Method and thresholds approved by competency framework administrator; individual adjustments via CMP-019.
features.implementation_status: Planned - No application code exists yet.
features.security_considerations: Organisation-scoped data; learner personal data never sent to an AI provider without authorisation (RAI-016); every AI call logged (SEC-011).
features.accessibility_considerations: Results readable by screen readers; charts have table equivalents; plain-language explanations.
features.failure_cases: Thresholds not configured for a framework -> score shown without a level plus 'levels not configured'.
features.acceptance_criteria: Same inputs always produce the same score; method version is stored with each estimate; the explanation lists contributing questions.
